ns2:course.label: ABE Principles: Machine Syst
ns2:course.description: Machinery systems for off-road applications: internal combustion engines; fluid power; tractors, and traction; chemical application; grain harvesting. Prerequisite: One of MATH 220, MATH 221, MATH 234.
